limitations: One-hour wall-clock workload includes explicit loss/reconnect recovery and re-establishment, not uninterrupted full occupancy.

Whole-system heap is sampled on owner pumping, nominally100ms; blocking crypto/SDK calls widen gaps and can hide transients. All reserved task stacks included. SDK per-region low-water sum is not one coincident instant.
Tracked peaks exclude SDK/PSA/application fixture allocations and allocator headers; do not add them to whole-system heap.
Largest/total-free ratio across heap regions is not an exact fragmentation percentage.
Compiler individual stack frames and observed watermarks do not prove worst-case stack bounds.
Root-node133attribute model,128events; not full three-phase-meter product or specification-wide maximum.
CASE sessions are established sequentially and held concurrently; simultaneous maximum PASE/CASE handshakes are not covered.
SDK allocation failure hook counts attempts; fallbacks may succeed. Injected failures cover tracked allocation positions, not every SDK allocation.
Three-second packet loss can retire sessions and subscriptions; every rebuild is counted.
The90secondCASEBUSYretry branch is not physically exercised in the final hour; staggered closes need zero admission retries.
Fabric publication/removal at setup/cleanup; no repeated remove/recommission while other fabrics remain under saturated traffic.
Development publicTESTattestation policy; no strict attestation, officialCSA, power-cut or routedIPv6/RIO result.
Windows IPv6 enabled by owner and preserved enabled; only temporary test Wi-Fi profile removed at cleanup.
